title: Spring Pumpkin and Pea Risotto
subtitle: with Cheesy Seed Crunch
description: Forget endless stirring! Our super-easy no-stir method will have this creamy pumpkin risotto cooked and on the table pronto. Topped with a crunchy pepita and feta cheese mix, there's a whole lot of yum in this bowl.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Peel the pumpkin and cut into 2cm chunks. Crumble 1 stock cube into a heatproof jug, add 750ml (3 cups) boiling water and stir to dissolve.
Cook garlic and pumpkin: Heat 2 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the garlic and pumpkin, stirring, for 3-4 mins until starting to soften.

Cook risotto: Add the rice to the pumpkin mixture and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until the grains are well coated. Add the stock, reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 16-18 mins until most of the liquid is absorbed and the rice is almost tender.

Make cheesy seeds: Meanwhile, heat a small frypan over medium heat. Crumble one-third of the feta into the pan, then add the pepitas and cook, scraping the base of the pan, for 5-6 mins until the cheese is golden and the seeds are toasted. Remove the pan from the heat.

Finish risotto and serve: Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the peas. Add the peas to the pan and cook for 1 min, then drain. Add the peas and remaining feta to the risotto and stir to combine. Cook for a further 1-2 mins until the rice and veggies are tender. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the risotto among bowls, top with the cheesy seeds and enjoy!
Make it yours: If you have any fresh herbs in the crisper drawer that need to be used, coarsely chop and scatter over before serving. Mint or parsley would both taste great.
